page: Microsoft Azure E16-4ads_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Eadsv7 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with multithreading enabled at 2 threads per core. The processor includes 32 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 48 KB of L1d cache, supporting advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, vector AES, and SHA extensions. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 32.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided via a 945 GB disk, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. It runs under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the E16-4ads_v7 demonstrates top-tier single-core performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU test, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression all rank in the top 10% of tested servers. Multi-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU score, and Redis SET operations placing in the average tier. Memory bandwidth is also average, measuring 48.62 GB/sec for large-block read-only operations and 34.0 GB/sec for large-block write operations. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and medium-model LLM prompt processing represent performance bottlenecks, falling into the bottom 25% of benchmarks.

The server offers high qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads due to its dense memory configuration of 128.0 GB RAM paired with only 4 vCPUs. This resource ratio avoids the cost of excess CPU licenses or allocation when memory capacity is the primary constraint. The combination of high single-core performance, substantial memory, and a 945 GB local disk makes this instance highly suitable for relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, single-threaded data processing pipelines, and web serving. It is less suited for highly parallelized multi-threaded compute tasks or large-scale LLM inference.
description: Microsoft Azure E16-4ads_v7 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server instance powered by a 4.5 GHz AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs, 128.0 GB of RAM, and a 945 GB local disk. Operating under Microsoft Hyper-V, it lacks GPU accelerators. The instance delivers top-tier single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded compression benchmarks ranking in the top 10%. Conversely, multi-threaded performance and medium-model LLM prompt processing are weaker, falling into the average and bottom tiers. With an exceptional memory-to-vCPU ratio of 32 GB per core, this server provides excellent qualitative cost efficiency for memory-constrained workloads. It is best suited for databases, in-memory caching like Redis, and single-threaded data processing.
